# NovoCare

> > NovoCare is Novo Nordisk's patient support and cost assistance platform providing savings programs, insurance coverage tools, and healthcare provider resources for diabetes, growth disorders, bleeding disorders, MASH, and women's health treatments.

The site serves both patients and healthcare providers (HCPs) with comprehensive support for navigating insurance coverage, prior authorizations, patient assistance programs, and prescription savings offers. NovoCare facilitates access to Novo Nordisk medications through tools like CoverMyMeds integration, coverage verification, and financial assistance programs including commercial insurance savings and Patient Assistance Programs (PAP).

## Key Topics

- Patient Assistance Programs (PAP)
- Prior Authorization
- Commercial Insurance (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS)
- Medicare and Medicaid Coverage
- CoverMyMeds Integration
- Savings Offers and Co-pay Support
- Insurance Coverage Verification
- Growth Hormone Treatments
- Diabetes Management
- JumpStart Programs
- TRICARE and VA Benefits
- Health Insurance Marketplace
- Prescription Cost Assistance
- HCP Support Resources

## Healthcare Provider Resources

- [Cost & Coverage for HCPs Treating Diabetes | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/hcp/diabetes/home.html): HCP resource hub for diabetes treatment coverage and patient savings
- [Diabetes Treatment Cost & Coverage Tool for HCPs | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/hcp/diabetes/check-coverage.html): HCP tool to verify patient insurance coverage for diabetes treatments
- [Start a Prior Authorization Process | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/hcp/diabetes/start-a-pa.html): HCP prior authorization process via CoverMyMeds for diabetes treatments
- [Cost & Coverage Support for HCPs Treating Growth-related Disorders | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/hcp/growth-related-disorders.html): HCP support hub for growth disorder coverage, prior auth, and patient help
- [Check Insurance Coverage for Growth-related Disorders | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/hcp/growth-related-disorders/check-coverage.html): HCP tool for patient coverage verification and QuickCheck requests
- [Access Support and Savings Resources for HCPs Treating Patients with MASH | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/hcp/mash/savings-and-support.html): HCP resources for MASH patient support and Wegovy enrollment services

## Diabetes Products and Savings

- [Check Coverage for NovoLog® (insulin aspart) injection 100 U/mL | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/diabetes/products/novolog/check-coverage.html): NovoLog insurance coverage verification and pharmacy cost estimator
- [Victoza® (liraglutide) injection 1.2 mg or 1.8 mg Savings & Support Resources | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/diabetes/products/victoza.html): Victoza savings offers, coverage info, and patient support resources
- [NovoPen Echo® Savings & Support Resources | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/diabetes-overview/let-us-help/novopenecho-savings.html): NovoPen Echo savings offer eligibility and activation for insulin pens

## Growth Disorder Support

- [Novo Nordisk Growth Disorder Medicine Savings Offers | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/growth-related-disorders/savings-offers.html): Savings offers for Sogroya, Norditropin, and growth disorder medicines
- [Growth Disorder Savings Program Eligibility | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/eligibility/growth-related-disorders-savings-offer.html): Novo Nordisk growth hormone savings offer eligibility and terms
- [Insurance Resources for Growth-related Disorders | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/growth-related-disorders/insurance-information/exploring-insurance/resources.html): Insurance coverage resources and PAP info for growth disorder treatment
- [Choosing Insurance for Growth-related Disorders | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/growth-related-disorders/insurance-information/exploring-insurance/choose-plan.html): Guide to choosing health insurance plans for growth disorders coverage

## Bleeding Disorders and PH1 Support

- [Bleeding Disorder Free Product Programs Eligibility | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/eligibility/bleeding-disorders-free-product-programs.html): Eligibility requirements for PAP, JumpStart, and Interim Programs
- [Health Insurance for Bleeding Disorders | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/bleeding-disorders/insurance-information/exploring-insurance/about.html): Insurance basics and coverage options for bleeding disorders treatment
- [Commercial Insurance for PH1 | NovoCare®](https://www.novocare.com/ph1/insurance-information/insurance-types/commercial.html): Commercial health plan options (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS) for PH1 coverage

## Insurance Coverage Information
